title: Getting Help
subtitle: Learn how to find assistance and support while using TaraHive.

blocks.text: If you need assistance while using TaraHive, several resources are available to help you learn about the application's features, resolve common issues, and contact the support team.

This user manual provides step-by-step instructions for the application's features. You can browse sections from the table of contents or navigate between topics to learn more about a specific feature.

items: Browse the manual using the navigation menu.
Read the Getting Started guide if you are new to TaraHive.
Refer to feature-specific sections for detailed instructions.
Check the Troubleshooting section for solutions to common problems.

blocks.text: Many common questions can be answered by reviewing the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) section of the documentation.

items: Account and sign-in issues.
Installation and updates.
Managing itineraries.
Using AI travel suggestions.
Troubleshooting common errors.

blocks.text: If you are unable to resolve an issue using the available documentation, you can contact the TaraHive support team for further assistance.

items: Describe the issue you are experiencing.
Include screenshots if applicable.
Provide the device and operating system you are using.
Mention the version of TaraHive installed on your device.

blocks.text: Providing detailed information helps the support team diagnose and resolve your issue more quickly.
If you discover unexpected behavior or encounter an application error, please report it so that it can be investigated and resolved in future updates.

items: Explain what happened.
Describe the steps to reproduce the issue.
Include screenshots or screen recordings when possible.
Specify the device, operating system, and TaraHive version.

blocks.text: Installing the latest version of TaraHive ensures that you receive new features, performance improvements, security updates, and bug fixes.

items: Check for application updates regularly.
Install updates when they become available.
Restart the application after updating if prompted.

blocks.text: Using the latest version of TaraHive provides the best experience and ensures compatibility with the newest features.
